name: Winoground: Probing Visio-Linguistic Compositionality
description: Winoground is an adversarial multimodal benchmark of 400 carefully curated image-caption pairs (800 images and 800 captions total) designed to evaluate whether vision-language models can understand compositionality. Given two images and two captions with identical words in different syntactic orders, models must pair each caption with its matching image.
